name: io.github.evictionsapi/evictions-api
title: Evictions API
description: Start and track a US eviction case in any state or DC; a licensed attorney reviews each real case.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. `Bearer <key>` with an Evictions API key, for the tools that work with cases; a client that supports MCP sign-in (OAuth) can sign in instead. The other tools need no key.
